purpose: spaceKLIP starlight subtraction of JWST NIRCam coronagraphy by KLIP (pyKLIP), on the pipeline version Balmer et al. (2025, AJ; arXiv:2503.13608) state for their HR 8799 reduction: jwst 1.12.1, CRDS 11.17.19, context jwst_1256.pmap.
license: spaceKLIP BSD-3-Clause; pyKLIP BSD-3-Clause; jwst BSD-3-Clause; webbpsf BSD-3-Clause

pins.spaceKLIP: spacetelescope/spaceKLIP develop at bcd9a96ec9781885d610426c6322797740df889d (2024-06-18), the merge of Balmer's #182 (coronagraph CRPIX from SIAF for the LWB narrow subarray, whose uncal headers are wrong) after #183 (square-root stretch and custom mask for alignment): the two changes the paper describes.
pins.pyKLIP: bitbucket pyKLIP/pyklip branch jwst at 1d44fc00e171073dd0a9cd0a80f8c172df085af5 (2024-05-24), the newest commit on that branch before the spaceKLIP pin; spaceKLIP names the branch, not a commit.
pins.libraries: Everything else at the release current in June 2024 inside jwst 1.12.1's declared ranges: stpipe 0.5.2, drizzle 1.14.4, asdf 2.15.2, gwcs 0.20.0, astropy 6.1.0, photutils 1.12.0 (webbpsf 1.3.0 needs 1.10 or newer), webbpsf 1.3.0, webbpsf_ext 1.2.1, pysiaf 0.22.0, scikit-image 0.23.2 (webbpsf_ext imports it without declaring it), setuptools 69.5.1 (pyKLIP imports pkg_resources). pip check passes.

data.note: The link webbpsf 1.3.0's installation guide gives as webbpsf-data-LATEST; on 2026-09-23 it served data version 2.1.0, above the 1.3.0 webbpsf requires. A NIRCam F410M MASKLWB PSF computes from it.
